canDoYue: 你識要帳單、分開計、用八達通，同埋指出單上面嘅錯。
canDoEn: Ask for the bill, split it, pay with an Octopus card, and point out a mistake.

dialogue.speaker: eddy
dialogue.text: Could we have the bill for this table before we leave?
dialogue.glossYue: 走之前可唔可以攞呢張檯嘅帳單？
dialogue.say: Could we have the bill for this table before we leave?

dialogue.speaker: nori
dialogue.text: Here is the full bill, and the service charge is included in the total.
dialogue.glossYue: 呢張係完整帳單，服務費包喺總數入面。
dialogue.say: Here is the full bill, and the service charge is included in the total.

dialogue.speaker: eddy
dialogue.text: Could we split the bill so each of us gets a separate receipt?
dialogue.glossYue: 可唔可以分開埋單，每人一張收據？
dialogue.say: Could we split the bill so each of us gets a separate receipt?

dialogue.speaker: nori
dialogue.text: Yes, we can split it, and I will show you the two amounts on this copy.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以分開，我會喺呢張單度顯示兩個數。
dialogue.say: Yes, we can split it, and I will show you the two amounts on this copy.

dialogue.speaker: eddy
dialogue.text: I will pay my separate amount with an Octopus card at the counter.
dialogue.glossYue: 我用八達通喺櫃檯畀我嗰份。
dialogue.say: I will pay my separate amount with an Octopus card at the counter.

dialogue.speaker: nori
dialogue.text: I can take that Octopus card when you are ready, then print a receipt.
dialogue.glossYue: 你準備好我就收八達通，然後印收據。
dialogue.say: I can take that Octopus card when you are ready, then print a receipt.

dialogue.speaker: eddy
dialogue.text: There is a clear mistake on the bill, and that soup was never on our order.
dialogue.glossYue: 帳單有個明顯錯，嗰碗湯我哋冇叫過。
dialogue.say: There is a clear mistake on the bill, and that soup was never on our order.

dialogue.speaker: nori
dialogue.text: I will correct that mistake and bring the corrected bill before you pay.
dialogue.glossYue: 我會改好嗰個錯，付款之前將改好嘅帳單帶畀你。
dialogue.say: I will correct that mistake and bring the corrected bill before you pay.
